Subject: NovusHealth DPA first pass and subprocessor inventory request

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Attached are NovusHealth's round 1 redlines to Redwood's DPA (PDF attached). A few priority asks so we can scope internal review: 

- Full subprocessor inventory (production + backups + cache layers) and a cadence for updates; if possible include the geographic region per subprocessor.
- Confirmation that cross-border transfers are governed by EU SCCs + UK Addendum where applicable; please confirm whether Redwood will sign the controller-controller addendum or provide the standard SCC-based module arrangement.
- Data retention and audit logs: need to understand default retention for logs and whether audit logs can be exported for an SOC review.
- Key management: Novus requires clarification on KMS/HSM usage for customer data at rest and whether customer-provided keys are supported for Dedicated or Private deployments.
- Execution logistics: we prefer an e-sign path (DocuSign) for the DPA + Exhibit A (subprocessor appendix). Please confirm the envelope flow and the contact for execution.

We appreciate a point-by-point response on the redlines and a timeline for getting a revised clean DPA + subprocessor inventory. Can we target a call early next week (Mon/Tue)?

Thanks,
Elliot Rodgers
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
NovusHealth

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: NovusHealth DPA first pass and subprocessor inventory request

Elliot / Priya — thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. High level positions below; Marissa, I’m looping you in for detailed counsel comments and suggested redline language.

Quick answers/next steps:
- Subprocessors: we can provide a full production subprocessor list and a separate line for backup & caching providers. For external sharing we typically provide a hashed list in the public portal and a secured CSV for contract counterparties. I’ve attached a blank template (subprocessor_inventory_requested.csv) we use to collect the extra fields you asked for (region, role, data types).
- Transfers: Redwood intends to use the EU SCCs (processor-to-processor where applicable) plus UK Addendum for UK entities. We do not sign controller-controller addenda as a standard for our hosted service; we can discuss mapping modules if Novus has a specific legal requirement.
- Retention & audit logs: default operational logs retained 90 days; audit logs are available for export under an approved data request and we can commit to providing extracts for audit with reasonable notice. We’ll confirm exact retention windows once Marissa weighs in.
- KMS/HSM: for Hosted API we use provider-managed KMS; Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) with HSM-backed KMS. We will detail which deployment types support which key model.
- Execution: DocuSign is fine; we can prepare a single envelope containing the DPA and Exhibit A. Proposed signers: Elliot Rodgers (Novus) then Karthik Iyer (Redwood COO) or Marissa for legal signoff.

Proposed timeline: Redwood returns a revised DPA + populated Exhibit A by 48 business hours after internal counsel checks (target: 2028-07-13). Call to discuss Monday 2028-07-15 — are you available for 10:00am PT?

I’ll flag the items where we expect pushback (indemnity, liability cap, customer-mandated HSM) so Marissa can provide editable language.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_requested.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovusHealth DPA — counsel notes and recommended edits

Karthik — quick internal counsel notes to use for the client response. My edits will be included in the redline, but summary below so you can set expectations on the call: 

Key positions I recommend we hold / propose alternatives for:
- Subprocessor disclosure: we should offer the full production list via secure portal and supply a timely notice for new subprocessors (30 days notice; emergency shorter notice + right to object). Refuse customer unilateral approval rights but offer right to suspend data flows for specific subprocessors while we remediate.
- Transfers & SCCs: accept EU SCCs for processor transfers; decline to sign controller-controller addenda (we are processor for hosted APIs). Offer to include an annex describing data flows and the modules used.
- KMS/HSM: accept customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private only. For Hosted we offer provider-managed KMS; propose a limited security commitment in the DPA (encryption at rest + TDE) and an SOC evidence offer.
- Liability & indemnities: do not accept open-ended indemnities for privacy claims. Keep liability cap at higher of fees x 12 months for DPA only. Offer carve-out for gross negligence/fraud.
- Audit rights: allow audit via third-party assessor once per year on-site or remote with NDA and scope limited to Redwood processing environment. For Hosted we will provide exportable audit logs instead of unlimited audit access.
- Retention: default log retention = 90 days; for regulated customers we can negotiate longer retention for an agreed fee and scope.

DocuSign flow: agree to single envelope with DPA + Exhibit A. We should use the "Sign in order" flow so Novus signs first. When we send to Novus, include an internal note pointing them to the secure portal for the full subprocessor CSV (not emailed).

I will prepare a tracked redline and a clean version for execution. Call prep notes attached as inline bullets (use during Monday call).

Marissa Cole
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

--- Internal draft guidance (bullet highlights for call):
- If Novus insists on controller-controller addendum, offer a mapping call to explain roles and consider a limited addendum for specific modules not full controller-controller signature.
- If Novus requires customer-supplied HSM for Hosted, propose Dedicated pilot (30-day transition) instead.

- Transfers: Redwood will execute EU SCCs + UK Addendum where applicable. We are not able to sign a controller-controller addendum for hosted API, but can provide a transfer annex describing modules and mapping.
- KMS/HSM: Hosted: provider-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private: customer-managed keys supported (BYOK/HSM).
- Retention & audit: default log retention = 90 days. Audit extracts available on request and we can support third-party audit under scoped terms.
- DocuSign: proposed envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-12345 (Novus signs first). Proposed signers: Elliot Rodgers (Novus) -> Karthik Iyer (Redwood, sign for execution). Please confirm sign order and whether Priya should sign as well.

Next steps: 
1) Confirm DocuSign signers and we will route the envelope today.
2) If you want a call, we’re available 2028-07-15 10:00am PT as proposed — let me know and I’ll send the calendar invite.
3) If Novus has a specific auditor request for a SOC evidence package, name the auditor and scope so Marissa can prepare the statement.

Looking forward to closing the DPA for execution this week.

Best,
